protocol:
Readout (v): the mirror cost table, plus the trades-per-turn distribution.

The protocol is `hexset.bots.heximax.search`'s own module docstring: three
four-seat games an arm, board seeds 0/1/2, every seat the same preset, arms
interleaved seed by seed, timed in one process on an idle box (paired -- the
absolute numbers drift with load, the ratio does not). The control is
`search2`; it used to be `search2-offers3`, heximax's own three-offer budget,
and there is no budget any more.

The trades-per-turn distribution is measured over the lineup readout (iii)
actually plays: `[heximax, heximax, search2, search2]`, blocked.
reading: The design's ceiling is <=2x `search2` per move (`hexset.bots.heximax.search`'s module docstring). Read the per-MOVE numbers: heximax's games are shorter, so a per-game total flatters it. The phase-neutral re-weighting that note also asks for is moot -- it existed because `search2` booked ~20x more TRADE_RESPOND decisions than heximax and those cheap decisions sat in the denominator, and there is no such phase any more.
